name: duplicate-file-finder
description: Find files that are exact copies of each other in your folders — compared by size and SHA-256 content hash, never by name — and see how much space they waste. One copy per group is kept automatically (the original-looking name, not “copy” or “(1)”), you can change which one, then export a report or move the extra copies into a review folder. Nothing is ever deleted, and moved files can be restored. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 找出文件夹里内容完全相同的文件——按大小和 SHA-256 内容哈希比对，不看文件名——并算出浪费了多少空间。每组自动保留一份（像原件的那个，不带“副本”“(1)”），你可以改选保留哪个，然后导出报告，或把多余副本移到待删文件夹。绝不直接删除文件，移走的文件还能放回原处。在本地运行，无需 API 密钥。
